authorization_scope: exactly one H7 fresh metadata acquisition run; image pixels remain closed
rerun_policy: If the authorized acquisition reaches the fresh-query execution step, no second random acquisition run is authorized even if a later technical step fails. Returned support is accepted as frozen, including request-error cells.
premeasurement_gate: At least 35 species must have exactly 30 retained fresh metadata photos in at least 5 of their 6 target cells. If not, H7 stops before pixels.
claim_ceiling: This authorization opens fresh metadata only. It does not authorize candidate image download, colour measurement, H7 inference, threshold changes, target substitution, replacement or backfill.
